Samir: Heads-up — after rolling FP8 enabled kernels to the L40S pool yesterday we saw intermittent throughput drops and tail jitter on long-context traces. Not constant regression, looks like the runtime is oscillating kernel choices mid-request. :thinking:
Samir: Paste from the runtime logs:```
[2025-11-03T14:23:07Z] kernel_selector: chose fp8_fast for layer 12
[2025-11-03T14:23:07Z] kv_cache: miss, triggering slow-path warmup
[2025-11-03T14:23:07Z] kernel_selector: fallback to int8_safe for layer 12 (latency spike)
[2025-11-03T14:23:07Z] runtime: switched execution path -> flush microbatch
```
Samir: Micro-bench results from the repro harness (batch=1, seq=4096, kv warmup scenario): FP16 baseline 140 tok/s, FP8 steady 210 tok/s but with 15% variance and 200ms tail spikes; when kernel flip occurs perf drops to ~80 tok/s.
Elaine: Yikes. Can you repro with a deterministic seed? Any relation to transformer-engine config differences between H100 and L40S? @Samir
Samir: Repro is flaky but I can force it with our long-context stress script. Differences: L40S uses TE bitslice=8 optimizations and H100 runs the TE fp8 kernel with different layout flags. The runtime's kernel election logic is using occupancy + perf probe; it seems to re-evaluate mid-inference if KV cache miss changes observed latency.
Dmitri: Sounds like a kernel "slew" problem — selector oscillates when it sees a transient KV cache miss. We should safelist kernels per model/shape so we don't flip during a single request. Also consider a hysteresis window on selector decisions (e.g., don't switch kernels within X ms or until next request).
Lucy: Agree on hysteresis. Also saw KV cache warmup evictions cause increased memory pressure on L40S which triggers a slowpath. Warming strategy might be too aggressive for long contexts. We should add a graded warmup that ramps KV warm entries over N tokens.
Elaine: Can we also log the transformer-engine config that runtime used when flip happens? Need exact flags (bitslice/layout/quant-mode). Right now logs only show kernel name.
Samir: Added a quick patch to include TE config in selector logs and pushed to staging (deploy 2259991200). Putting a safelist toggle behind feature-flag: runtime.fp8_kernel_safelist=true.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: deployment staging/eng-runtime@sha256:aa7f0... succeeded at 2259991200
Dmitri: Proposed two immediate mitigations: 1) kernel safelist per model+shape, 2) 200ms selector hysteresis default. Also add metric kernel_switch_count tagged by request_id so we can alert on unusual flip rates.
Lucy: I'll prototype graded KV warmup (start with 25% of kv entries on first 512 tokens, ramp). Will run against L40S pool tomorrow morning.
Elaine: If safelist + hysteresis fixes stabilize, we can enable FP8 for H100 and L40S with audit mode (forced fp8 but reject if kernel_switch_count > threshold).
Samir: Thanks — collecting follow-ups: add TE-config log, add kernel_switch_count metric, implement safelist flag + hysteresis, prototype graded KV warmup. Planning to run a 6h soak on L40S after changes. :thumbsup:
Elaine: SGTM, @Samir pls post soak results and attach perf histograms. :eyes:
